quote: Figure 2(a) and (b) are the backscattering electron image (BEI) and x-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns of equilibrated alloy #12 (Cu-31.5at.%Se-32.5at.%Te), respectively. Three phases were observed. The chemical composition of the dark phase is Cu-35.18at.%Se1.28at.%Te, which is the Cu2Se phase, and the composition of the gray phase is Cu-42.68at.%Se-23.27at.%Te, which is a ternary phase. Hereafter, this phase is denoted as the s1 phase. The dendritic microstructure contains a white matrix and some gray precipitate phases. Its average composition is Cu-32.12at.%Se-40.39at.%Te which was a liquid Te-rich phase at 500  C, which was solidified during the quenching from the furnace.
